maria_support: Customer on Dedicated is getting a 400 when calling our Node SDK chat API. They say curl to the same host works but SDK returns 'unknown route'.
kevin_platform: Which SDK version and exact error text? Any stack trace?
maria_support: They sent this snippet. SDK: @redwood/inference-node@0.9.1
```
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-1', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'hi' }] });
// Error: 400 Bad Request: unknown route: /v1/chat.create
```
kevin_platform: Curl works? show the curl command.
maria_support: Yes, curl to the same dedicated URL succeeds:
```
curl -X POST https://dedicated.example/api/v1/chat.create \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}] }'
```
alex_dev: This smells like the runtime route naming changed in last rollout. New runtime expects `/v1/llm/chat` and the payload uses `inputs` not `messages`. Old SDK calls `/v1/chat.create` which the new router doesn't recognize and returns 400 unknown route.
jen_sre: Deploy-bot: rollout runtime-v1.3.0 -> prod started 1760000800 by @deploy-bot :gear: (note for timeline)
kevin_platform: Repro for eng: 1) npm i @redwood/inference-node@0.9.1 2) call client.chat.create(...) 3) observe 400 unknown route. Please add a unit test for compatibility layer.
alex_dev: For support: two short-term workarounds: 1) ask customer to install canary SDK that maps legacy calls (`npm i @redwood/inference-node@canary` v1.0.0-canary.x) 2) if they can't upgrade, add a small request middleware to rewrite path + payload. Example: 
```
client.on('beforeRequest', (req) => {
  if (req.path === '/v1/chat.create') {
    req.path = '/v1/llm/chat';
    req.body.inputs = req.body.messages;
    delete req.body.messages;
  }
});
```
maria_support: Customer also reported a few intermittent 401s when using the older SDK. Could that be related?
alex_dev: Auth format didn't change. Those 401s could be their proxy returning an HTML 401 page because the SDK hit an unknown path and proxied differently. We'll check logs.
kevin_platform: Opening INF-2345 for eng-runtime to add a compatibility shim and document breaking changes. Assigning to @alex_dev. Link: https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-2345
jen_sre: I've added a Datadog monitor to alert on spikes of 400 unknown-route errors originating from node sdk versions <1.0.0.
maria_support: I'll send the canary suggestion plus the middleware snippet to the customer and ask them to retry. Will report back.
alex_dev: I'll draft a hotfix to add a runtime redirect rule and add a test in the SDK to avoid regressions.
redwood-bot: INF-2345: issue created and linked to PR draft #987 by alex_dev
maria_support: Customer confirmed the canary fixed the issue. Marking customer resolved; keeping thread open until INF-2345 PR merges. Thanks all :raised_hands:
jen_sre: Setting a follow-up reminder for next week to verify the shim rollout.
